supplements.title: Gut microbes mediate the synergistic effects of dietary cholesterol and saturated fat in driving fibrosing MASH.
supplements.summary: Gut bacteria triggered by high saturated fat and cholesterol diets drive liver fibrosis by activating liver cells, offering new treatment targets.

supplements.title: EGCG-mediated selenium nanoparticles protect against 5-fluorouracil-induced cardiotoxicity via Nrf2/Keap1 signaling.
supplements.summary: EGCG-selenium nanoparticles protect the heart from 5-fluorouracil chemotherapy damage by reducing oxidative stress and inflammation.

supplements.title: Synergetic anticancer activity of psidium guajava-mediated palladium nanoparticles via apoptosis induction and metastasis suppression in osteosarcoma cells.
supplements.summary: Guava-based palladium nanoparticles effectively kill osteosarcoma (bone cancer) cells by triggering cell death and blocking cancer spread.

supplements.title: Enhancing the therapeutic efficacy of curcumin in topical applications through nanoformulations.
supplements.summary: Nanoformulations enhance curcumin's absorption in skin, improving its effectiveness against skin cancer and wound healing.

supplements.title: Apigenin based nanoplatform achieves non-small cell lung cancer immunotherapy through glycolysis inhibition and photodynamic co-perturbation of organelles.
supplements.summary: A nanoplatform combining apigenin and light therapy inhibits lung cancer growth by blocking energy metabolism and triggering immune cell activation.

supplements.title: Thermodynamic stability and anticancer activity of 2,3-unsaturated and 2,3-dideoxy O3-betulin glycosides.
supplements.summary: Modified betulin compounds with attached sugars show enhanced anticancer activity against breast cancer cells with high selectivity.

supplements.title: Btg2 inhibits Fmo1 UFMylation thus exacerbating ferroptosis and apoptosis in hepatic ischemia-reperfusion injury.
supplements.summary: Blocking the Btg2 protein reduces liver damage during surgery by preserving an enzyme that prevents cell death.

supplements.title: Oral delivery of enterocyte-mimetic butyrate-loaded nanoparticles repairs the gut barrier and inhibits growth of digestive system tumors.
supplements.summary: Oral nanoparticles that repair the gut barrier and deliver butyrate effectively inhibit digestive system tumor growth and spread in mice.

supplements.title: Flavor and bioactive compound profiling of sea buckthorn leaf tea: Characterization of key bitter constituents and prediction of their anti-type 2 diabetes activity.
supplements.summary: Fermented sea buckthorn leaf tea reduces bitterness while preserving compounds that may help prevent type 2 diabetes.

supplements.title: Vitamin D remodels the tumor microenvironment to suppress gastric cancer progression through cancer-associated fibroblasts-secreted exosomal miR-378c targeting KDSR.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D suppresses gastric cancer progression by reprogramming cancer-supporting cells to release molecules that boost anti-tumor immunity.

supplements.title: Machine Learning-driven Prediction of Cervical Cancer Cell Viability After Treatment With Thymoquinone, Curcumin, and 5-Fluorouracil.
supplements.summary: Machine learning models predict how cervical cancer cells die when treated with natural compounds thymoquinone and curcumin, rivaling traditional chemotherapy drug effectiveness.

supplements.title: Baicalin as a multifunctional flavone glycoside: pharmacological mechanisms, ADME profile, and therapeutic potential.
supplements.summary: Baicalin, a plant compound, shows promise against inflammation, cancer, and infections by activating protective cellular pathways and improving immune responses.

supplements.title: Hypovitaminosis D in acute inpatient cancer rehabilitation: Prevalence, predictors, and practical implications.
supplements.summary: Most cancer patients in rehabilitation have low vitamin D levels, which may worsen their health outcomes and recovery.

supplements.title: Myricetin Alleviates Vibrio vulnificus Elastase-Induced Autophagy and Apoptosis in Human Intestinal Epithelial Cells via Inhibition of NF-κB-Mediated Signaling.
supplements.summary: Myricetin, a plant flavonoid, protects intestinal cells from a bacterial toxin by reducing harmful cellular stress signals and preventing cell death.

supplements.title: Omega-3 fatty acids in Pediatric Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia: A Scoping Review.
supplements.summary: Omega-3 fatty acids show promise in laboratory tests for killing leukemia cells and reducing chemotherapy side effects in children with acute lymphocytic leukemia.

off_label.title: Identification of PRRG1 as a possible molecular target of pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: PRRG1 protein drives pancreatic cancer growth through a key signaling pathway, and low-dose warfarin effectively blocks this effect.

off_label.title: Targeting UXS1-Dependent Glucuronate Detoxification Potentiates Metformin's Anti-Tumor Efficacy in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking UXS1 enzyme combined with metformin kills lung adenocarcinoma cells and boosts immune responses in preclinical studies.

off_label.title: Tofacitinib as a Successful Treatment for Hyper-IgE Syndrome and Autoimmunity Associated with Constitutive Activation of JAK3.
off_label.summary: Tofacitinib successfully treated a patient with rare JAK3 mutations causing high-IgE syndrome and autoimmune disease.

off_label.title: Tamoxifen attenuates postsurgical hindlimb swelling and soft-tissue fibrosis in a rat model of secondary lymphatic injury.
off_label.summary: Tamoxifen reduces post-surgical limb swelling and tissue scarring in rats by lowering oxidative stress after lymph node removal.

off_label.title: Therapies for Infantile Haemangiomas: Current Practice and Evolving Perspectives.
off_label.summary: Beta-blocker propranolol became the transformative first-line treatment for infantile hemangiomas, replacing older toxic therapies with superior efficacy and safety.

off_label.title: Systemic Metabolic Dysfunction Drives Platelet-Mediated Inflammation, Fibrogenesis, and Hepatocarcinogenesis in MASLD.
off_label.summary: Metabolic dysfunction activates platelets to trigger inflammation, fibrosis, and liver cancer, suggesting antiplatelet drugs like aspirin could help treat the disease.

off_label.title: Bibliometric analysis of the association between asthma and cancer: Mechanistic insights and directions for clinical translation.
off_label.summary: Research reveals asthma may increase or decrease cancer risk depending on inflammation type, suggesting personalized treatment approaches targeting specific asthma subtypes.

off_label.title: Environmentally relevant concentrations of PFDA exacerbate inflammatory bowel disease through impairing macrophagic efferocytosis of apoptotic intestinal epithelial cells.
off_label.summary: PFDA chemical exposure worsens inflammatory bowel disease by damaging immune cells, but metformin may reverse this harmful effect.

off_label.title: When the host is not healthy: Rethinking tuberculosis drug targets in comorbid conditions.
off_label.summary: TB drugs work differently in patients with other diseases; research should test treatments in realistic conditions with comorbidities like diabetes and cancer.

off_label.title: Quizartinib-induced resistance drives clonal emergence of MV4-11 cells with molecular alterations enabling multidrug antileukemic escape.
off_label.summary: FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia cells develop resistance to quizartinib through genetic mutations and metabolic changes, but combining it with p53 or MAPK inhibitors restores drug sensitivity.

off_label.title: Chronic stress and cancer progression through neuro‑endocrine‑immune networks (Review).
off_label.summary: Chronic stress may accelerate cancer progression through stress hormone pathways affecting immune function and tumor microenvironment, suggesting psychosocial interventions warrant investigation.

off_label.title: NUPR1 as a central stress-adaptation node in cancer: integrating metabolic rewiring, cell death, and therapy resistance.
off_label.summary: NUPR1 protein helps cancers survive stress and resist treatments by controlling metabolism, cell death, and immunity; blocking it with drugs could overcome resistance.

off_label.title: Akkermansia muciniphila drives viscero-visceral crosstalk via 5-HT3aR-mediated sensitization of dichotomizing gut-bladder neurons.
off_label.summary: A gut bacterium (Akkermansia muciniphila) causes bladder dysfunction by triggering excess serotonin, which could be reversed by blocking serotonin receptors.

off_label.title: Metformin inhibits mitochondrial complex I in intestinal epithelium to promote glycaemic control.
off_label.summary: Metformin lowers blood sugar by blocking a protein in intestinal cells, forcing them to absorb excess glucose and convert it to lactate.

off_label.title: A Phase II Pilot Trial of ABemacicliB or Abemaciclib and HydroxYchloroquine to Target Minimal Residual Disease in Breast Cancer Patients ('ABBY')
off_label.summary: A trial tests whether combining abemaciclib and hydroxychloroquine pills can eliminate cancer cells remaining in breast cancer patients' bone marrow.

biomarkers.title: Gut microbes mediate the synergistic effects of dietary cholesterol and saturated fat in driving fibrosing MASH.
biomarkers.summary: Gut bacteria triggered by high saturated fat and cholesterol diets drive liver fibrosis by activating liver cells, offering new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Microbiota and head and neck cancers: Mechanistic insights and translational potential.
biomarkers.summary: Bacteria imbalances in the mouth and tumors promote head and neck cancer growth and may predict treatment response.

biomarkers.title: Radioiodinated compound FJR01: a novel P2X7R-targeted SPECT tracer for visualizing glioma-associated microglia/macrophages in a rat glioblastoma model.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed FJR01, a new radioactive tracer that successfully visualizes glioblastoma tumors by targeting immune cells within the tumor microenvironment.

biomarkers.title: Structural optimization of CHI3L1 inhibitors with improved pharmacokinetics and functional activity in 3D glioblastoma models.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers optimized a glioblastoma drug candidate that better blocks a tumor-driving protein while improving how the body processes it.

biomarkers.title: Spontaneous hemothorax in Neurofibromatosis type 1 with a giant intrathoracic meningocele and intracystic hematoma: Diagnostic value of postmortem CT.
biomarkers.summary: A woman with Neurofibromatosis type 1 died from sudden bleeding into her chest caused by a ruptured spinal fluid sac.

biomarkers.title: A case of prostatic urothelial carcinoma with aggressive metastasis: Magnetic resonance imaging as an initial diagnostic clue.
biomarkers.summary: MRI's diffusion-weighted imaging helped identify rare primary prostatic urothelial carcinoma with aggressive metastasis that was initially mistaken for bladder cancer.

biomarkers.title: A case of intrapulmonary schwannoma in a patient with rectal carcinoma: A case report and literature review.
biomarkers.summary: A rare lung schwannoma was identified in a patient with rectal cancer using imaging techniques to distinguish it from metastatic disease.

biomarkers.title: Renal angiomyolipoma with inferior vena cava tumor thrombus in a pregnant woman.
biomarkers.summary: A pregnant woman was diagnosed with a rare benign kidney tumor that spread into a major vein, successfully treated after delivery.

biomarkers.title: Quantitative native T1 mapping identifies papillary muscle and intracavitary cardiac lipomas: A multiparametric CMR case series.
biomarkers.summary: Native T1 mapping helps accurately identify benign cardiac lipomas in complex heart locations using magnetic resonance imaging.

biomarkers.title: The role of hypoxia in the regulation of serotonergic signaling: an investigation of HTR1B and TPH-1 expression in colorectal cancer and C. elegans models.
biomarkers.summary: Hypoxia in colorectal cancer alters serotonin receptor genes in time-dependent ways, suggesting potential therapeutic targets.

biomarkers.title: The FOXM1-SESN2 axis maintains redox homeostasis and protects esophageal squamous carcinoma cells from oxidative stress.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that FOXM1 and SESN2 proteins work together to protect esophageal cancer cells from oxidative stress and cell death.

biomarkers.title: Evaluating 18F-FDG PET-CT for Regional Lymph Node Assessment in Advanced Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers evaluated whether a PET-CT imaging scan accurately detects lymph node spread in advanced upper tract urinary cancer before surgery.

biomarkers.title: Exploring the Immune Microenvironment for Predicting Immunotherapy Efficacy in Epstein-Barr Virus-Associated Gastric Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Immune cell patterns in tumors, not standard markers alone, predict which EBV-associated gastric cancer patients will respond to immunotherapy.

biomarkers.title: [Adult pulmonary blastoma:a case report].
biomarkers.summary: A 21-year-old with pulmonary blastoma achieved favorable outcomes through combined neoadjuvant chemotherapy, surgical resection, and adjuvant immunotherapy.

biomarkers.title: [Interstitial pneumonia with primary pulmonary atypical carcinoid tumor and multiple brain metastases: a case report].
biomarkers.summary: Atypical pulmonary carcinoid tumors can be misdiagnosed as interstitial lung disease, delaying cancer detection and treatment.

trials.title: Reiki and Therapeutic Touch for symptom burden and quality of life in palliative settings: A systematic review.
trials.summary: Reiki and Therapeutic Touch may help reduce symptoms and improve quality of life for palliative care patients.

trials.title: Caring at the crossroads of culture and emotion: a reflective case study of person-centred end-of-life practices.
trials.summary: Emotional burden on nurses and cultural barriers limit compassionate end-of-life cancer care delivery in Chinese hospitals.

trials.title: A case of prostatic urothelial carcinoma with aggressive metastasis: Magnetic resonance imaging as an initial diagnostic clue.
trials.summary: MRI's diffusion-weighted imaging helped identify rare primary prostatic urothelial carcinoma with aggressive metastasis that was initially mistaken for bladder cancer.

trials.title: Minimally invasive management of colonic lipoma causing intussusception with endoloop in an adult.
trials.summary: Doctors successfully treated colon intussusception caused by a lipoma using minimally invasive endoscopy instead of surgery.

trials.title: Biopsy with same-session MRI-guided laser interstitial thermal therapy versus biopsy alone in patients with primary unresectable glioblastoma: a multicentre randomised controlled trial.
trials.summary: Early-stopped trial shows MRI-guided laser therapy combined with biopsy may benefit glioblastoma patients who cannot undergo surgery.

trials.title: Evaluating 18F-FDG PET-CT for Regional Lymph Node Assessment in Advanced Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma.
trials.summary: Researchers evaluated whether a PET-CT imaging scan accurately detects lymph node spread in advanced upper tract urinary cancer before surgery.

trials.title: Exploring the Immune Microenvironment for Predicting Immunotherapy Efficacy in Epstein-Barr Virus-Associated Gastric Cancer.
trials.summary: Immune cell patterns in tumors, not standard markers alone, predict which EBV-associated gastric cancer patients will respond to immunotherapy.

trials.title: [Adult pulmonary blastoma:a case report].
trials.summary: A 21-year-old with pulmonary blastoma achieved favorable outcomes through combined neoadjuvant chemotherapy, surgical resection, and adjuvant immunotherapy.

trials.title: Biomarkers of Injury Severity in Shoulder Instability and Posttraumatic Osteoarthritis.
trials.summary: Blood biomarkers like periostin and TNF-alpha may help predict injury severity and guide shoulder instability treatment decisions.

trials.title: Persistence of PET scan positivity after chemoimmunotherapy for DLBCL.
trials.summary: Some lymphoma patients with positive PET scans after chemotherapy don't actually have remaining cancer, and blood tests may help identify them.

trials.title: Characteristics associated with clinical response to pomalidomide in hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia.
trials.summary: Pomalidomide effectively reduces severe bleeding in hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia, especially in patients with worse baseline symptoms and younger age.

trials.title: CRLF2 rearrangement and extramedullary disease in B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia: a possible link?
trials.summary: CRLF2 genetic mutation in B-cell leukemia is strongly linked to spread of cancer outside the bone marrow, occurring in 90% of affected patients.

trials.title: Molecular features of response and resistance to glofitamab, a T-cell engager for treatment of large B-cell lymphoma.
trials.summary: Fresher, naïve-like T cells at treatment start predict glofitamab success in B-cell lymphoma, with 4-1BB combination enhancing response.

trials.title: Gallium-Containing Agents for Tumor Diagnosis and Therapy: Current Status and Future Prospects.
trials.summary: Gallium-based agents improve cancer diagnosis and treatment by enabling precise imaging and attacking tumors through multiple biological mechanisms.

trials.title: Expert consensus on optimal management of liver-related adverse events during CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy.
trials.summary: Experts provide guidance on managing liver toxicity in breast cancer patients receiving CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy to improve treatment outcomes.
